name: gcp-log-investigation
description: Cursor pack with a portable log-reader subagent and production-safe guidance for investigating Google Cloud application logs across Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and GKE.
author: felipeblassioli

lite.description: Installs the reusable log-reader subagent and usage guides without persistent project rules.

strict.description: Installs the log-reader plus project-only safety guidance for production and sensitive-data handling.

notes: Strict installs add persistent project guidance for bounded queries, redaction, and concise summaries.
User installs skip rules because Cursor user rules are managed in settings rather than a ~/.cursor/rules directory.
